ja251:0.4: By the cleansing of lustful thoughts,
ja251:1.2: and by the sharpening of thought –
ja251:1.3: Not by adorning, not by blessings,
ja251:2.1: Not by shooting from the ear,
ja251:2.3: By (defilements) I’m pierced in the heart with a fire in all my limbs.
ja251:3.1: I can see no wound (on my body) from where the blood might flow out,
